meaning_by_symbol.NEW:: prefix indicating that new symptoms have appeared after stabilization

reply.rationale: No defensible compositional paradigm is supported by the supplied codebook. All three items are standalone symbols, and there are no multi-symbol codes showing substitution in a shared frame, no recurring forms with stable compositional contributions inside larger entries, and no evidence that any substring participates in a productive construction. In particular, although NEW: is described as a prefix semantically, no attested complex entries are provided that contain it, so treating it as a morpheme inside a construction would be unsupported. Therefore the safest analysis is a flat lexicon.
